about: The business pack (3 Oct 2026): what the core deck had tilted toward after Rina's VC story. Merged in with --pack business.

role.name: The investor
role.line: You decide who gets money, and everyone knows it
role.changes: Every warm word to you might be a pitch · diligence is a reason to ask anything

role.name: The founder
role.line: You built it, and it is starting to own you
role.changes: Every friendship is also a reference

world.name: The startup
world.line: Twelve people, one runway, no walls
world.changes: Work and life are the same room · everything ships tonight

world.name: The firm
world.line: The hours are long and the floors are numbered
world.changes: Hierarchy is literal · a mistake is billable

pressure.name: The audit
pressure.changes: Every lie costs more as the clock runs

pressure.name: The raise
pressure.line: The money comes with people attached
pressure.changes: Every yes is owed to someone

pressure.name: The merger
pressure.line: Two houses, one name at the end
pressure.changes: Somebody's people will not survive it

undercurrent.name: The pitch got personal
undercurrent.line: It was business, until it was not
undercurrent.changes: The deal and the feeling want different endings
signals: they remember a detail from a meeting you thought was only business
a message that arrives after hours and isn't about the work
someone in the room notices how you two talk
the paperwork asks a question you don't want to answer honestly
if_full: the deal closes and the feeling is never said
it comes out at the worst possible meeting, in front of everyone
undercurrent.if_resolved: the job and the feeling are separated, and one of them is given up on purpose

secret.name: Conflict of interest
secret.line: If you fall for them, you cannot back them
secret.changes: The job and the feeling cannot both win
